GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_period, f.channel_id, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(net_amount) as total 
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, f.channel_id
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, f.channel_id

SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.net_amount) as web_sales
FROM fact_web_order w
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT d.fiscal_period, COUNT(*) as web_orders, SUM(w.order_total_gross) as total_gross
FROM fact_web_order w
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON DATE(w.order_ts_utc) = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period AS period,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS net_sales
FROM fact_web_order w
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
